name: United Rentals, Inc.
business: Largest US equipment-rental company (general and specialty rentals).

news.title: Record Q2: revenue $4.4B, adj. EPS $12.76; FY26 revenue guide raised to $17.5–17.8B
Management: large-project pipeline accelerating, specialty demand strong

pros: Mega-project demand (data centers, manufacturing) driving raised guidance
cons: Diesel cost $5.34/gal YTD vs $3.66 a year earlier
take: Cycle leader with raised guidance and a long project pipeline; fundamentals supportive. (Only graded with a larger account — 1 share > position cap.)

metrics.summary: United Rentals, Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates as an equipment rental company in the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. It operates through two segments, General Rentals and Specialty.
